Method of Attack: Monitors and terminates processes that attempt to delete shadow volume copies using vssadmin.exe commands such as 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' and 'vssadmin.exe resize shadowstorage'.
Registers raccine.exe as a debugger for vssadmin.exe via the Image File Execution Options Windows registry key to intercept and kill invoking processes attempting to delete shadow copies.
Impacted Systems: Windows systems using volume shadow copies
Attack Vector: Execution of vssadmin.exe commands to delete shadow volume copies
Indicators of Compromise: Use of vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet command
Use of vssadmin.exe resize shadowstorage command
Processes invoking vssadmin.exe attempting to delete shadow copies
